result.summary: Page is largely intact with no critical breakage, but found 2 layout text-clipping issues: the featured 'Tokumaru Ramen' title is cut off, and the carousel item 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated without ellipsis.

issues.description: Restaurant title under 'Popular right now' reads 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final 'n' clipped where the title meets the '4.8 (500+)' rating on the same line
issues.suggestion: Fix title-rating row constraints to prevent clipping: allow the title to truncate with ellipsis and add minimum spacing so the last character is never cut off

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows restaurant name as 'Trattoria Piccol' truncated mid-word at the screen edge without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with ellipsis and ensure card layout handles long names gracefully in the horizontal carousel
